summary: Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed (auth guard, data CRUD, profile, cross-account data isolation with 2 Mongo-seeded users, logout invalidates token). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): login screen renders without token, direct access to /pesanan is redirected to /login, QA token in localStorage opens Dashboard with profil-card showing qa.lpm@example.com, bottom tab order is exactly [Dashboard, Pesanan, Supplier, Persediaan, Customer, Ekspor] (verified via href attributes), profile edit (nama pemilik/toko/wa) persists after reload, supplier add persists after reload, persediaan add persists after reload (needed to open Picker modal and tap picker-item-__BARU__), pesanan create+edit persist after reload with NO duplicate (card count 1 before and after edit), and Keluar akun returns to login screen and clears localStorage so a hard reload still shows login. No React Native deprecated packages, red-screen errors, or raw-text-outside-<Text> issues observed. Debounced writes (~700 ms) are honored by sleeping ≥2 s before reload. No code changes were required to make tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: POST /api/auth/session catches httpx.HTTPError and returns 401, but if the external Emergent OAuth endpoint is reachable yet returns non-200, 401 is returned too — fine, but a short log line would help diagnose production login failures.
data_routes.py PUT /api/data cap of 5000 entries is enforced only for pesanan+belanja; suppliers list is unbounded. Low priority since user-driven, but worth capping.
store/index.tsx: initial fetchData error (non-401) is swallowed — the UI stays with empty state and no error toast. Consider surfacing a toast if sync remains 'error' after first load.
seed_data_creation: Seeded two QA users directly in Mongo: user_qa0000000001 / qa.lpm@example.com with session_token qa-token-123, and user_qa0000000002 / qa2.lpm@example.com with session_token qa-token-456. QA session for frontend (qa-token-123) was re-seeded at the end of testing so the token is valid for subsequent agents. App_data for both QA users was reset to empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python /tmp/seed_qa.py` or the snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md to re-seed qa-token-123 if missing. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_lpm_backend.py — note they wipe app_data for both QA users as part of setup. Frontend uses testIDs like login-google, profil-card, profil-edit-toggle, input-nama-pemilik/toko/wa-toko, simpan-profil, sup-nama/sup-tambah, pers-picker-jenis + picker-item-__BARU__, pesanan-toggle-form, picker-jenis + picker-item-<jenis>, item-jml-<jenis>, input-transfer, simpan-pesanan, lihat-detail-<id>, ubah-pesanan-<id>, logout-btn. Pesanan form requires nama/wa/alamat/kota/kec + at least one item with jml>0 + transfer>0, otherwise simpan silently toasts and does nothing.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found during this round.
